all_distinct(xs: List[int]) -> bool =
  ex all_distinct([1, 2, 3]) == True
  ex all_distinct([1, 1]) == False
  var i = 0
  while i < xs.len()
    var j = i + 1
    while j < xs.len()
      if xs[i] == xs[j]
        return False
      j += 1
    i += 1
  True

mix(seed: int, i: int) -> int =
  pre i >= 0
  ex mix(1, 2) == mix(1, 2)
  -- multiplying by an odd constant and reducing mod 2^32 is a bijection
  -- on [0, 2^32), so distinct i give distinct ids for a fixed seed
  (i * 2654435761 + seed % 4294967296) % 4294967296

make_ids(n: int, seed: int) -> List[int] =
  pre n >= 0
  post out.len() == n
  post all_distinct(out)
  ex make_ids(0, 7) == []
  ex make_ids(3, 7) == make_ids(3, 7)
  var out: List[int] = []
  for i in range(0, n)
    out.append(mix(seed: seed, i: i))
  out
